SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PO_NO, KEY_2 AS PO_SEQ, KEY_10 FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TR' AND TARGET = 'KRHWAS0031' AND KEY_9 = 'N' GROUP BY DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_10
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER ,A.PO_NO ,A.PO_SEQ ,NVL(A.LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO ,NVL(A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,CASE WHEN GR_QTY = ITEM_QTY THEN '입고완료' WHEN GR_QTY <> 0 THEN '부분입고' WHEN DI_QTY = ITEM_QTY THEN '배송완료' WHEN DI_QTY <> 0 THEN '부분배송' WHEN IV_QTY <> 0 THEN '배송준비중' WHEN DO_QTY <> 0 THEN '수주접수' WHEN DO_QTY = 0 THEN '발주' END AS STATUS FROM ICOMPODT A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_9 = 'N' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 ='$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 = '$G_RS.KEY_10$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_9 = 'N' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 ='$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 = '$G_RS.KEY_10$'
